title: verify-gate attestation (issue #882)
description: Every scripts/verify.sh run writes exactly one .verify/attestation.json matching this shape, on PASS and on FAIL alike (a gate that only attests when it is green is a false-green risk, GR-12). The overall verdict is the worst of the per-check verdicts -- never better than any check it ran.

run_id.description: A unique identifier for this gate run (never reused across runs).

git_sha.description: The commit under test, or the literal 'unknown' when git could not resolve HEAD (never a fabricated sha).

overall_verdict.description: The worst verdict among checks[]. OK requires every check OK; any WARN with no FAIL yields WARN; any FAIL yields FAIL.

skip_ratchet.description: The skip ratchet's own record (issue #1199): which skipped checks are NAMED (a standing gap against an open issue, or a venue limit against an absent named precondition), and which are not. A run whose skip set is not accounted for here cannot be quoted as a green board -- scripts/lib/validate-attestation.py refuses the record by name.

budget.description: The named, shrink-only exemption record this run was asserted against (repo-relative).

verdict.description: OK: every skip is named. VIOLATION: an unnamed skip, a stale exemption, or an entry naming an undiscovered check. CANNOT-ASSESS: the record could not be evaluated -- never a pass.

standing_skips.description: The NAMED skips of this run, each with the kind of blindness it declares. A `venue` entry names the precondition this venue fails to supply (issue #1361): either the repo-relative PATH that is absent (`precondition`, with `precondition_kind: path`) or the COMMAND the venue must be able to run (`precondition` carries the command itself, with `precondition_kind: command` and `precondition_present` measuring it) -- scripts/lib/validate-attestation.py refuses a `venue` skip that declares neither.

unbudgeted_skips.description: Skipped checks that NO entry names -- refused by the ratchet and by this validator's accounting rule.

stale_entries.description: `standing-gap` exemptions whose check assesses now: they must be deleted, the list can only shrink.

unused_venue_entries.description: Venue exemptions whose precondition was PRESENT in this run, so they did not bite. Reported, never a failure: the precondition de-activates the entry.

duration.description: Wall-clock seconds the check ran for.

evidence_tail.description: The last lines of the check's own output (may be empty for a check that printed nothing).
